_comment: Awin feeds used by Sporty Gear World. advertiserId is the Awin advertiser id (file names AWIN_<advertiserId>_<feedId>.csv.gz in the Awin archive folders). Without feedIds, every file of that retailer is read. Add a retailer only after Awin has approved the programme. allowPaths (lessons L65): only products from these sport sections of the shop's category path come in, never a tool or tech shop's product because its name has a sport word. First version (25 Oct 2026, after the sports feed scan): Coes, Joybuy UK, Plusshop UK, Bazta UK (the same catalogue at two prices, lessons L40) and Beyond Shakers. VEVOR NL comes in a second wave (owner, 25 Oct 2026). Cronjager (29 Oct 2026, owner): a marketplace of about 50 brands with one feed per currency, so only its GBP feed (95541) and only its sport brands (brands): padel (Aixo), surf (Circle One Surf, Rad Wax), kayaks (Fatyak), gym flooring and judo mats (Sprung), court and sports kit (Central Sports UK), hiking packs (Kelty and Sierra Designs from Twist Distribution). Its jewellery, clothing and home products are on WGW, MGW, HGW and GGW (lessons L84 on the new-shops branch). sectionHints false (plan, 25 Oct 2026): the shop's own sub-section never picks the category (Coes puts every sport product under the Awin category 'Fitness'; Joybuy's sub-sections are often wrong), only the product name does. retailer is the name shown on the site.
